description: Runs a package.json script via `npm run <script>`, `pnpm run <script>`, or `yarn run <script>` and returns structured output with exit code, stdout, stderr, and duration. Auto-detects package manager via lock files (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm).

args.description: Additional arguments passed after -- to the script

filter.description: pnpm workspace filter pattern (e.g., '@scope/pkg', './packages/foo'). Only used with pnpm.

ifPresent.description: Don't error if the script is missing — useful in heterogeneous monorepos (maps to --if-present)

packageManager.description: Package manager to use. Auto-detected from lock files if not specified (pnpm-lock.yaml → pnpm, yarn.lock → yarn, otherwise npm).

parallel.description: Run workspace scripts in parallel (maps to --parallel for pnpm)

recursive.description: Run script in all workspace packages (maps to --recursive for pnpm, --workspaces for npm)

script.description: The package.json script name to run

scriptShell.description: Override the shell used to run scripts (maps to --script-shell)

silent.description: Strip npm/pnpm log chrome from output (maps to --silent)

stream.description: Stream output with package name prefixes (maps to --stream for pnpm)

workspace.description: Workspace target(s) — maps to npm --workspace or pnpm --filter for unified workspace targeting

name: run

packageManager.description: Package manager that was used (npm, pnpm, or yarn)

success.description: Whether the script exited with code 0

timedOut.description: Whether the script was killed due to timeout

title: Run Script
